newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Adelaide Brighton lifts cement group stake.
newsitem.headline: Adelaide Brighton lifts cement group stake.

text.p: Cement producer, Adelaide Brighton Ltd said on Thursday it had lifted its stake in Victorian-based cement group Independent Cement and Lime (ICL) to 50 percent from 38 percent.
In a statement to the Australian Stock Exchange (ASX), Adelaide Brighton said it had acquired the 12 percent interest from two private investors.

"The move means ICL, a major cement distributor, is now a 50-50 joint venture between Adelaide Brighton and the Melbourne-based Barro Group, an independent quarry and premix concrete operator prominent in Victoria," the company said.

ICL operates a waterfront cement terminal in Port Melbourne, and distributes bulk and bagged cement in Victoria and southern New South Wales. It has an associated company, Steel Cement Ltd, which operates a slag-grinding plant at Port Melbourne.
Adelaide Brighton is 49 percent owned by Australian Cement Holdings which is a joint venture company between CSR Ltd and Pioneer International Ltd.
